Figures of paper C3a, written by benchmarks/c3a_figures.py into this folder and into its run record
runs/20261018-161440_c3a_figures (same PDFs, plus PNGs; the numbers the figures show are in its
result.json, the git commit in its meta.json). Journal style: drawn at the printed two-column width
(510 pt), 8 pt STIX text. Every figure reads only the stored runs listed below; runs marked invalid
are refused. Constants in the script: roton spinodal 89.845 a0 (run 20261005-143507), metastable
window 90.237-90.274 a0 (run 20261008-123945), E_b = 14.4926 at 90.0 a0 (Newton, fixed N; RESULTS).
